reading: Skybox Datacenters is a privately held hyperscale data center developer headquartered in Dallas, Texas. Rob Morris founded the company in 2014 and serves as chief executive officer, with Travis Young as co-founder and chief financial officer. Morris brought 18 years of mission critical facility design and construction experience to the venture. Skybox describes its core offering as PowerCampus, an end to end development, design, and construction service for large scale data center campuses, delivered as turnkey builds, build to suit projects, or powered shell. A related entity, Skybox Critical Operations, provides facilities management once campuses are built. The company reports developing more than 2.5 gigawatts of projects across North America, with active markets in Dallas, Austin, Houston, and Wichita Falls in Texas, Chicago, Northern Virginia, Santa Clara, and San Francisco. In this registry, Skybox is recorded against two Illinois and Texas facilities, consistent with its Chicago and Texas campus activity. Skybox's business model places it alongside other privately held hyperscale developers already profiled in this registry, including Vantage Data Centers, STACK Infrastructure, and Aligned, all of which build large power dense campuses for hyperscale and large enterprise tenants rather than leasing small colocation suites directly to many customers. Unlike Vantage and STACK, which have disclosed institutional ownership through DigitalBridge, Silver Lake, and IPI Partners respectively, Skybox's site and available secondary sources do not publish its capitalization structure or outside investors as of the research date. No SEC filings exist for the company, consistent with private ownership. Data center trade press has covered individual project approvals, including a Round Rock, Texas site, but has not published aggregate capacity or financial figures beyond the company's own 2.5 gigawatt development claim.
